import numpy as np,json,os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for p in ['1','2','3']:
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])
    print('=== Demo',p,'in ',I.shape,'out',O.shape)
    for r in range(I.shape[0]):
        ii=''.join(str(x) for x in I[r]); oo=''.join(str(x) for x in O[r])
        print(ii,' | ',oo)
    # non-1 cells inside vs outputs
    nI=np.argwhere((I!=1)&(I>0))
    nO=np.argwhere((O!=1)&(O>0))
    print('non1 in:',sorted(nI.tolist()),' out:',sorted(nO.tolist()))

def best_align(R,O,name):
    h,w=R.shape; oh,ow=O.shape

            D=n=0
            for r in range(h):
                for c in range(w):
                    rr=r+dr; cc=c+dc
                    if 0<=rr<oh and 0<=cc<ow:
                        n+=1
                        if R[r,c]!=O[rr,cc]: D+=1
            rec.append((D,n,dr,dc))
    rec.sort(key=lambda x:(x[0],-x[1]))
    return rec[:4]
